title: HAFiscal run-provenance sidecar
description: Small, travelling provenance record written next to a run's outputs as RUN_<run_id>.prov.json. Emitted by Code/HA-Models/provenance.py. Never stored inside a result file's bytes.

git_dirty.description: Working-tree dirty at run start. null = unknown (only for reconstructed sidecars, where run-time dirtiness is unrecoverable).

reconstructed.description: True if this sidecar was reconstructed AFTER the fact from an authoritative log (not captured live during the run). Live captures omit this or set false.

reconstructed_from.description: Source of the reconstructed facts (e.g. the run log path).

wrapper_env.description: HAFISCAL_* env vars plus BLAS thread counts EXPLICITLY present at run start (the subset a human exported). For the full surface see all_known_flags.

set_flags.description: ONLY the ENV_FLAGS.md-registry HAFISCAL_* flags that were SET, mapped to their value in force. Unset flags are intentionally omitted — they take their code default at git_commit. Reproduce by setting these values and checking out git_commit.

env_flags_registry.description: Pointer to the authoritative flag registry (ENV_FLAGS.md) + counts (flag_count/flags_set/flags_unset), so the omitted (unset) flags can be resolved to their documented defaults at the recorded commit.

reuse.description: Schema v2: what the run actually REUSED (cache HITs, guarded ad_full verdicts, belief seeds, platform observations), collected in-process at each reuse decision point. determinism_class is DERIVED: 'cache-history-dependent' iff any event has byte_effect 'tolerance' (documented tolerance-class reuse), else 'pure-config'. Platform events never flip the class. v1 sidecars (no reuse key) remain valid.

source_child.description: Set on events ingested from a battery child's fragment.
